title: Route a Hindi government-service request to the form filling skill
description: This verifies that a Hindi natural-language request is understood and routed to the form filling skill with a confirming message.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Send a command request with a user ID and a Hindi request to fill an SSC form
Verify the response shows the form filling skill was matched
Verify a confirmation message for the intended action is returned

title: Extract text from a readable document image
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can upload a readable document image and receive extracted OCR text in the response.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Open the OCR processing workflow
Upload a readable document image containing text
Submit the OCR request
Verify extracted text is returned
Verify an OCR result object is shown

title: Generate a downloadable PDF resume from valid profile details
description: This verifies that providing complete resume data produces a generated PDF resume that the user can download.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Open the resume generation workflow
Fill in valid resume details
Submit the resume generation request
Verify a generated PDF resume is available
Verify the resume download control is shown

title: Route an informal request to the fallback skill
description: This verifies that an informal natural-language request is routed to the closest matching fallback skill and returns a confirming response.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Send a command request with a user ID and an informal request for a shayari
Verify the response shows the fallback skill was matched
Verify a confirmation message for the routed action is returned

title: Reject an unsupported command
description: This verifies that an unsupported natural-language command returns a clear no-match or cannot-understand error instead of routing to a skill.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Send a command request with a user ID and an unsupported command
Verify an error response is shown for the unsupported command

title: Return a consistent response shape for command routing
description: This verifies that a successful command routing response includes the expected routed skill and message fields for the user.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Send a command request with a user ID and a valid government-service request
Verify the routing response includes a matched skill
Verify the routing response includes a confirmation message

title: Reject an empty command
description: This verifies that submitting an empty command is blocked with a clear validation error instead of creating a routed action.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Send a command request with a user ID and an empty command
Verify a command validation error is shown

title: Reject a missing or unreadable OCR upload
description: This verifies that submitting no file or an unreadable image in the OCR workflow returns a clear input or processing error.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Open the OCR processing workflow
Submit the OCR request without selecting a file
Verify an OCR input validation error is shown

title: Block resume generation when required details are missing
description: This verifies that incomplete resume data is rejected with a clear missing-field error instead of generating a resume.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login credentials for the required role
Submit the login form
Open the resume generation workflow
Fill in incomplete resume details
Submit the resume generation request
Verify a missing required fields error is shown
